messages:
Ada: quick flag: ran a mixed small+large inference workload with the new host-prefetch prototype. p95 spiked by ~22ms vs baseline when host staging and prefetch both enabled
Ben: can you share the run config and a short flamegraph?
Ada: config: ```yaml
host_prefetch:
  enabled: true
  mode: user_space
  lookahead_ms: 15
  max_pages: 4096
  dedupe_prefix: true
```
Ben: flame shows a lot of kernel read faults plus our staging compaction CPU work. looks like prefetch is increasing transient live set and causing extra compaction cycles.
Carla: that matches my local repro. Prefetching + immediate compaction is a churn loop. We need hysteresis: don't compact pages that were recently prefetched unless residency_age > X.
Dmitri: +1 on hysteresis. Also think about prefetched-page priority at eviction time: give prefetched pages a softer eviction score until they've had a chance to be used.
Ada: experiment note: toggling dedupe_prefix reduced duplicate page migration by ~60% and lowered P95 by ~9ms in the same run. dedupe seems important for KV-backed warmups.
Ben: UX idea: route-level policy with fields {prefetch_enabled, prefetch_profile, eviction_bias, madvise_mode} where prefetch_profile is one of {interactive, balanced, throughput} and madvise_mode is {none, madvise, user}.
Carla: for private customers we should expose a madvise toggle and document that madvise may bypass our eviction accounting (kernel behaves differently). include caveats about swap and kernel reclaim.
Dmitri: infra telemetry: propose PREFETCH_RUN event with tags {route, tenant, profile, pages_migrated, dedupe_hits, compaction_triggered, sample_trace_id}. we'll need to wire sample_trace_id to perf traces in staging.
infra-bot: logged: PREFETCH_RUN schema registered in telemetry catalog
Ada: API boundary: we need a small handshake so allocator can ask offload-agent to prefetch then observe outcomes. sketch: PREPREFETCH(route, hint_id, budget_pages) -> agent returns hint_id; agent later posts PREFETCH_DONE(hint_id, stats). allows runtime to revert policy mid-rollout.
Ben: important: include a cancel path PREPREFETCH_CANCEL(hint_id) so runtime can abort long-running prefetch when SLO pressure is detected.
Carla: implementation caveat: avoid allocating pinned pages during prefetch unless customer explicitly requests pinned=true. pinned pages reduce fragmentation but block eviction. default should be non-pinned.
Dmitri: rollout plan: add handshake + telemetry to canary in staging, enable dedupe + conservative profile by default. run 48h + compare p95, p99, throughput across tenant mixes.
Ada: numbers from my run: conservative profile (dedupe on) -> p95 improved vs throughput-profile by 14ms and throughput down 4%. throughput-profile -> tokens/sec +8% but p95 +22ms. tradeoff is real.
Ben: action list:
- Carla: proto schema for route policy + madvise toggle (PR)
- Dmitri: PREFETCH_RUN telemetry + trace linking (PR)
- Ben: add PREPREFETCH / PREFETCH_DONE / PREFETCH_CANCEL signals in allocator-agent shim (prototype)
- Ada: create staging canary job and metrics dashboard (dash)
Carla: also add slab telemetry tag prefetched=true so compactor can prioritize coalescing prefetched fragments differently.
Ada: will draft a short RFC capturing the profile semantics, hysteresis rules, and canary metrics. pinging @Ben and @Dmitri for early review. :thumbsup:
Dmitri: will review tomorrow morning.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: prefetch-handshake canary scheduled: eng-runtime/staging 2026-03-25T04:00Z
Ben: thanks infra-bot.
Carla: quick Q: how will this interact with KV cache warming? we should surface dedupe stats in cache-warm logs to avoid double-work.
Ada: noted, add dedupe cross-check to telemetry tasks.
Ben: agree keep defaults conservative in hosted to avoid noisy regressions for existing customers.
Ada: ack. RFC incoming.
